standard_talents.name: Life Drain
standard_talents.description: Kill a minion to restore 150 HP.

core_talents.name: Weapon Master
core_talents.description: Physical Attack and Magic Power gained from equipment and emblems increased by 15%.

standard_talents.name: Tenacity
standard_talents.description: When HP is below 50%, gain 15 extra Physical and Magic Defense.

core_talents.name: Concussive Blast
core_talents.description: Every 15s, your next Basic Attack deals extra Magic Damage equal to 120 + 4% of your Max HP to nearby enemies.

standard_talents.name: Master Assassin
standard_talents.description: Deal 7% extra damage to a single enemy hero.

core_talents.name: Fatal Snare
core_talents.description: When dealing damage to an enemy hero, deal extra 30-60 adaptive damage and slow them by 20% for 1s.

standard_talents.name: Bargain Hunter
standard_talents.description: Equipment prices are reduced to 90% of their original price.

core_talents.name: Impure Rage
core_talents.description: Dealing damage with skills deals extra 30-100 adaptive damage and restores 2% of Max Mana.

standard_talents.name: Festival of Blood
standard_talents.description: Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each kill or assist grants 0.5% extra Spell Vamp (up to 12%).

core_talents.name: Unbending Will
core_talents.description: Damage dealt increases by 0.2% for every 1% of HP lost (up to 12%).

standard_talents.name: Pull Yourself Together
standard_talents.description: Battle spell cooldown is reduced by 15%. Equipment cooldown is reduced by 15%.

core_talents.name: Focus Mark
core_talents.description: When dealing damage to an enemy hero, your team deals 6% extra damage to them for 3s.

standard_talents.name: Fatal
standard_talents.description: Gain 5% Critical Chance and 10% Critical Damage.

core_talents.name: Weakness Finder
core_talents.description: Basic Attacks have a 20% chance to slow the target by 90% and reduce their attack speed by 50% for 1s.
